summary.text: PDC scored 385 all out in their first innings with Mohit Kale hitting 73 off 123 balls, while Sunil Kumar took 6 for 98 against them. JK responded with 555 for 6 declared as Shubham Khajuria top-scored with 190 off 330 balls, and Sagar Udeshi claimed 2 for 85. PDC reached 269 for 6 in their second innings, led by Ankit Sharma with 62 off 120 balls, as Waseem Bashir took 2 for 35 before the match was drawn.
